meta.name: M6S Sugar Riot — Boss + H2 Scholar Core + Rotation
meta.strategy: M6S Boss Mechanics + H2 Scholar + 30s DoT / 60s Aetherflow / mechanic-aligned Chain
meta.author: FF14 Timeline Voice Coach
meta.description: M6S Boss + H2 Scholar timeline with Scholar DoT reminders every 30 seconds. Chain Stratagem keeps the mechanic-aligned delayed burst timings from the core healing plan instead of forcing a rigid 120-second cadence: 124.0s, 258.0s, and 360.5s. DoT reminders are merged into nearby Scholar calls where possible; otherwise they use a concise standalone '補毒' cue placed near the intended 30-second refresh while preserving the 2000ms collision window. Aetherflow reminders are chained off its own 60-second recast rather than a fixed clock grid: each cast is placed at the earliest quiet slot that is both off cooldown and at least 2500ms clear of every other cue, so the 2000ms collision window stays empty. Windows where healing does not consume the stacks also mention dumping the surplus into Energy Drain. All cues remain enabled.
